items.title: Implementing PostgreSQL logical replication between Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL instances on separate AWS Outposts
items.summary: Learn how to configure PostgreSQL logical replication between two Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL instances on separate AWS Outposts racks, keeping all replication traffic and backups within your on-premises environment by using Customer-owned IP addresses and Local Gateways, without any data traversing the AWS Region.
items.creator: Belma Canik
